description:
About CWILL
 CWILL (pronounced 'quill') is a post-purchase and retention suite built for Shopify brands. Reduce support tickets, recover lost revenue from returns, and turn one-time buyers into loyal fans — with tools purpose-built for every touchpoint that follows the sale.
 About the Role
 We're building AI agent capabilities for Shopify merchants across order tracking, AI chat and customer support workflows, supported by Shopify data integration, the merchant admin and reporting.
 As an R&D Trainee, you'll learn through mentorship, hands-on development and direct customer interaction. During your first three months, you'll help with customer support and small customizations to understand merchant needs, while building the skills to own full-stack features independently.
 Product Intro: 
 https://www.cwill.com/products/ai-chat/ 
 Base location required: 
 Cary, NC
 (We are unable to hire in other states; relocation will be required.)
 Hybrid remote working setting
 What You'll Do
 Customer Issue Support 
 Investigate and resolve technical issues from user and support tickets, quickly finding the root cause across frontend and backend (data errors, API errors, display problems and more)
 Classify issues by type and severity, respond quickly to urgent ones and drive fixes to completion
 Document frequent issues as troubleshooting guides and FAQs to reduce repeat tickets
 Work with support and product to reproduce problems, and provide data corrections or workarounds when needed
 Work directly with merchants alongside the customer success team to understand their workflows, assist with product setup and resolve technical questions
 With guidance from your mentor, deliver small customer-specific customizations and turn recurring requests into reusable product improvements
 Customer Collaboration and Customization 
 Help clarify customer requirements, assess technical feasibility and implement scoped customizations with your mentor
 Prioritize urgent customer issues with the team, communicate progress clearly and verify that fixes address the customer's problem
 Product Improvements 
 With guidance from your mentor, develop features across order tracking, AI chat, Shopify data integration, the merchant admin and reporting — from frontend and backend development through testing and release
 Help build and improve AI agent capabilities such as order lookup, delivery-status assistance, knowledge-base responses and human handoff
 Improve performance, refactor code and reduce technical debt to make the system more stable and responsive
 Improve frontend interactions and page load speed, and optimize backend API performance and database queries
 Join requirement reviews and give input on technical feasibility
 Your Growth Path
 Months 1–3: Learn the product, architecture and main workflows. Work directly with merchants alongside customer success, help resolve support requests and deliver small customizations. Complete small features and bug fixes with your mentor.
 By 6 months: Independently deliver small full-stack features from requirements through release, diagnose common production issues and translate customer needs into technical solutions.
 By 12 months: Own a product module or technical area, including feature delivery, reliability and ongoing improvements informed by customer feedback.
 Requirements 
 Requirements 
 Bachelor's degree or higher in Computer Science, Software Engineering, Information Technology or a related field; Class of 2026 or recent graduate
 Strong programming fundamentals and comfortable coding in at least one of Java, Go (Golang), Python or JavaScript, including Node.js for backend development. Able to build, debug and explain your code. Prior Go experience is optional; willingness to learn the team's technology stack is expected
 Frontend basics (HTML, CSS, JavaScript) and at least one framework (React or Vue)
 Backend fundamentals: HTTP, RESTful API design and MVC; able to build basic APIs on your own
 At least one relational database (MySQL or PostgreSQL): able to write SQL and understand indexes and transactions
 Comfortable using Git for version control and team collaboration
 Good coding habits, with attention to readability and maintainability
 Strong learner who picks up new technologies quickly and solves problems by reading documentation
 Clear logical thinking: able to break down problems and explain technical choices
 Good communication and ownership; you share progress proactively and stay calm under pressure
 Professional working proficiency in Mandarin Chinese and English (you will work daily with our engineering team in China)
 Nice to Have 
 A complete full-stack project you can show (coursework, competition, open source or internship)
 Internship experience on a software team
 Familiarity with TypeScript, Docker, CI/CD or cloud services (AWS, GCP, Alibaba Cloud, etc.)
 An active GitHub history or technical blog
 Programming competition awards (e.g., ICPC)
 Experience with Shopify apps or APIs, order tracking, customer support tools, or AI applications such as agents, chatbots and knowledge bases
 Hands-on experience with AI coding tools such as Cursor, Codex or Claude Code
 Benefits 
 Starting Pay: 80k - 110k depends on experiences, open to negotiation
 401(k) 
 PTO 
 Paid Holidays 
 Insurance
